references.text: The Israelites camped on the plains of Moab, across the Jordan from Jericho—the same place mentioned in Num 35:1.
Moses and Eleazar spoke to the people on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho—the same geographical location.
The people gathered at the camp on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho.
Describes the Israelites' arrival at the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho, where the Lord spoke to Moses.
Concludes with the same location reference: the commands and laws that the Lord gave through Moses on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho.
Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo—this happened after the events described in Num 35.
Refers to the inheritance distribution that Moses gave on the plains of Moab.
